edges.reason: msg.sender determines whose dividends are converted in reinvest().
exit() acts on the token balance and dividends of msg.sender.
withdraw() updates payoutsTo_ and transfers ETH to msg.sender.
sell() burns tokens from msg.sender's ledger entry.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the token source.
myTokens() reads the balance of msg.sender.
myDividends() reads dividends of msg.sender.
purchaseTokens() credits msg.sender and keys the pre-mine table on it.
getState() reports cookie and cookie balance of msg.sender.
MoonInc.transfer() moves cookies of msg.sender.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender of the allowance.
approve() writes the allowance of msg.sender.
sellAllCookies() liquidates the cookies of msg.sender and pays it.
recipient of _customerAddress.transfer is msg.sender in withdraw().
msg.sender.transfer(value) in sellAllCookies can reenter the caller.
startTime is compared against now to gate sells and purchases.
require(now >= startTime) makes sell() timestamp dependent.
pre-mine windows and ambassador sequencing depend on now.
globally unclaimed cookie accrual depends on block.timestamp.
per-player unclaimed cookie accrual depends on block.timestamp.
updatePlayersCookie stores block.timestamp as the settlement time.
sellAllCookies payout depends on the time weighted sell price.
computeSellPrice is entirely driven by now and the start time array.
local _customerAddress in withdraw is msg.sender.
local _customerAddress in sell is msg.sender.
local _customerAddress in reinvest is msg.sender.
local _customerAddress in purchaseTokens is msg.sender.
buy() forwards msg.value to purchaseTokens.
fallback purchases tokens with msg.value and no referrer.
reinvest reads current dividends via myDividends.
reinvest dispatches an internal buy order through purchaseTokens.
exit sells all of the caller's tokens.
exit withdraws the remaining dividends.
transfer withdraws outstanding dividends before moving tokens.
transfer derives the dividend value from the token fee via tokensToEthereum_.
sell converts the burned tokens to ETH via tokensToEthereum_.
sellPrice is computed from tokensToEthereum_.
buyPrice is computed from tokensToEthereum_.
calculateTokensReceived uses ethereumToTokens_.
calculateEthereumReceived uses tokensToEthereum_.
purchaseTokens computes the minted token amount via ethereumToTokens_.
MoonInc constructor deploys the first production unit.
createProductionUnit1Beta delegates to the factory.
createProductionUnit2Beta delegates to the factory.
createProductionUnit3Beta delegates to the factory.
the factory deploys a new ProductionUnitToken whose constructor runs.
handleProductionIncrease settles cookies before increasing production.
handleProductionDecrease settles cookies before decreasing production.
getState reports totalSupply().
getState reports balanceOf(msg.sender).
getState reports computeSellPrice().
totalSupply adds balanceOfTotalUnclaimedCookie.
balanceOf adds balanceOfUnclaimedCookie.
MoonInc.transfer settles production for msg.sender first.
transferFrom settles production for the source player first.
sellAllCookies settles accrued cookies before pricing them.
sellAllCookies prices cookies with computeSellPrice.
computeSellPrice divides by totalSupply().
sell performs an external value call to moonIncContract after mutating state.
transfer performs an external value call to moonIncContract after mutating state.
transfer performs a second external call to moonIncContract for the recipient.
purchaseTokens performs an external value call to moonIncContract.
withdraw sends ETH with transfer() allowing fallback reentry.
sellAllCookies zeroes the balance then sends ETH to msg.sender.
MoonInc.transfer mutates cookieBalance with unchecked arithmetic.
updatePlayersCookie mutates roughSupply and cookieBalance without SafeMath.
sellAllCookies computes myCookies * sellPrice / 1 ether without SafeMath.
computeSellPrice multiplies pool by 1 ether and multiplier without SafeMath.
reinvest casts _dividends * magnitude to int256 and adds it to payoutsTo_.
withdraw casts _dividends * magnitude to int256 and adds it to payoutsTo_.
ethereumToTokens_ squares price parameters and tokenSupply_ without overflow protection.
MoonInc fallback adds msg.value to the pool with unchecked addition.
transferFrom decrements balances and allowances with unchecked arithmetic.
createProductionUnitTokenContract deploys an untrusted/unsafe-to-handle new contract.
tokensToEthereum_ squares tokens_ without overflow protection.
buy receives _referredBy and passes it into the purchase flow.
_referredBy flows from buy into purchaseTokens.
_amountOfTokens is the sell amount consumed by sell().
_toAddress is the transfer destination in transfer().
_amountOfTokens is the transferred amount in transfer().
_incomingEthereum drives fee and token math in purchaseTokens.
_referredBy selects the referral branch in purchaseTokens.
recipient receives the cookies in MoonInc.transfer.
amount bounds the cookie debit in MoonInc.transfer.
_customerAddress is the ETH recipient of the transfer in withdraw().
_dividends is the ETH value sent out in withdraw().
_customerAddress is passed to the external MoonInc call in sell().
_dividends is the ETH value forwarded to the external call in sell().
_updatedPayouts is the scaled int256 value subtracted from payoutsTo_.
_referralBonus is added to dividends before the int256 cast in reinvest/withdraw flows.
_referralBonus flows into the referral accounting of purchaseTokens.
_dividends is the value passed to the external call from purchaseTokens.
_dividends is the ETH value attached to the external MoonInc call.
_amountOfTokens * cookieProductionMultiplier is passed to MoonInc and can overflow.
myCookies is multiplied by sellPrice in the unchecked ETH value computation.
value is the ETH amount sent to msg.sender in sellAllCookies.
supply is the divisor in the unchecked price computation.
multiplier is multiplied into the unchecked price computation.
lastTokenContractStartTime is selected from the start-time array relative to now.

normalization_plan.reason: _referredBy is the parameter of buy() and only affects the purchase flow of that function.
_amountOfTokens is the parameter of sell() and is consumed only there.
_toAddress is the parameter of transfer() and is used only as the recipient.
_amountOfTokens is the parameter of transfer() and is consumed only there.
_incomingEthereum is the parameter of purchaseTokens and drives all of its math.
_referredBy is the parameter of purchaseTokens used for the referral branch.
recipient is the parameter of MoonInc.transfer and only receives cookies.
amount is the parameter of MoonInc.transfer bounding the debit.
_customerAddress is a local of withdraw() aliasing msg.sender.
_dividends is the local ETH amount sent by the withdraw transfer.
_customerAddress is a local of sell() aliasing msg.sender.
_tokens is the local burned amount inside sell().
_ethereum is the local bonding curve output inside sell().
_dividends is the local fee value carried into the external MoonInc call.
_taxedEthereum is the local credited ETH inside sell().
_updatedPayouts is the local int256 cast subtracted from payoutsTo_.
_customerAddress is a local of reinvest() aliasing msg.sender.
_dividends is the local dividend amount cast to int256 in reinvest().
_tokens in reinvest() is the return value of purchaseTokens.
_customerAddress is a local of purchaseTokens aliasing msg.sender.
_undividedDividends is a local fee split inside purchaseTokens.
_referralBonus is a local referral split inside purchaseTokens.
_dividends is the local ETH value passed to the external MoonInc call from purchaseTokens.
_taxedEthereum is the local amount converted to tokens inside purchaseTokens.
_amountOfTokens is multiplied by cookieProductionMultiplier and passed to MoonInc.
sellPrice is the local price multiplied into the unchecked payout value.
myCookies is the local balance multiplied in the unchecked payout value.
value is the local ETH amount transferred to msg.sender in sellAllCookies.
supply is the local divisor in the unchecked sell price computation.
lastTokenContractStartTime is a time-selection local inside computeSellPrice().
secondsPassed is a time delta local inside computeSellPrice().
multiplier is the local factor feeding the unchecked sell price computation.
